label.zh-CN: 电动垂直起降/飞机推进

label.en: Application and machine type (aircraft, drone, robot joint, vehicle, marine, generator)
label.zh-CN: 应用和设备类型（航空器、无人机、机器人关节、车辆、船舶、发电机）

suggestions.value: Generator, rotation set by the engine

label.en: Generator, rotation set by the engine
label.zh-CN: 发电机，转向由发动机决定

label.en: Motor or generator mode (or both, regeneration) and direction of rotation (one / both)
label.zh-CN: 电动机或发电机模式（或两者兼有、再生制动）及旋转方向（单向／双向）

label.en: Mission profile: each phase with torque, speed and duration (takeoff, climb, cruise, landing ...)
label.zh-CN: 任务曲线：各阶段的转矩、转速和持续时间（起飞、爬升、巡航、着陆等）

label.en: Power (when the torque is not given)

help.en: Enter the S1 power when the torque is not known. When torque and speed are given, the power is derived from them.
help.zh-CN: 不知道转矩时填写 S1 功率。给出转矩和转速时，功率由二者计算。

help.en: Where the stated power is measured: at the shaft, at the motor's electrical input, or at the DC bus (generator output).
help.zh-CN: 所给功率的计量位置：轴端、电机电气输入端，或直流母线（发电机输出）。

help.en: Enter the speed and the torque, or the power when the torque is not known. With torque and speed the shaft power is derived.
help.zh-CN: 输入转速和转矩；不知道转矩时输入功率。给出转矩和转速时，轴功率由二者计算。

label.en: Peak torque and speed, how long and how often (s, duty cycle)
label.zh-CN: 峰值转矩和转速、持续时间及频次（秒、占空周期）

label.en: Repeat period (start of one peak to the start of the next)
label.zh-CN: 重复周期（一次峰值开始到下一次开始）
最高转速及超速要求（验证／失控）
飞逸转速（失去负载或控制时）

label.en: Required efficiency at the key points
label.zh-CN: 关键工作点的效率要求

label.en: Allowed torque ripple and cogging (% pk-pk), frequencies to avoid (resonances)
label.zh-CN: 允许的转矩脉动和齿槽转矩（峰峰值百分比）、需避开的频率（共振）
最大齿槽/启动阻力转矩
寿命（小时、循环次数、启停次数）

label.en: Additional requirements (one line per requirement, e.g. cut-in speed, controller input-voltage window, field weakening)
label.zh-CN: 其他要求（每行一项，如切入转速、控制器输入电压范围、弱磁）

help.en: Anything this form does not ask for. Write one requirement per line.
help.zh-CN: 本表未涉及的任何要求，每行写一项。

label.en: Battery: chemistry, cells in series, V min under load / nominal / max
label.zh-CN: 电池：化学体系、串联节数、负载最低／标称／最高电压

label.en: At which voltage each operating point must be reached (especially peak and max speed at V min)
label.zh-CN: 各工作点必须达到的电压（尤其是最低电压下的峰值和最高转速）
电池电流限制（连续／峰值）

label.en: Controller: manufacturer and model, or own design; who supplies it
label.zh-CN: 控制器：制造商和型号或自研；供应方

label.en: Power devices: SiC / IGBT / GaN, voltage class
Phase current limit: continuous and peak (A rms) and peak duration
label.zh-CN: 相电流限制：连续值和峰值（A RMS）及峰值持续时间

label.en: Switching frequency, modulation (SVPWM / DPWM), field weakening allowed
label.zh-CN: 开关频率、调制方式（SVPWM／DPWM）、是否允许弱磁

label.en: Position sensor: resolver / encoder / Hall / sensorless
label.zh-CN: 位置传感器：旋变／编码器／霍尔／无传感器

label.en: Number of phases and redundancy (one 3-phase, dual 3-phase, 6-phase)
label.zh-CN: 相数和冗余（单三相、双三相、六相）

label.en: Independent winding sets (e.g. 2 for two 3-phase windings)
label.zh-CN: 独立绕组组数（如两套三相绕组为 2）

label.en: Cable length motor - controller, connector type
label.zh-CN: 电机至控制器的电缆长度、连接器类型

label.en: Insulation requirements: class, hipot, partial discharge (800 V class), creepage
label.zh-CN: 绝缘要求：等级、耐压、局部放电（800 V等级）、爬电距离
所需温度传感器（类型、数量、位置）

label.en: Cooling: air (still / forced / propeller wash / ram air, speed through the motor) or liquid (coolant, inlet temperature, flow, pressure drop)
label.zh-CN: 冷却方式：空气（静止／强制／螺旋桨气流／冲压空气及流经电机的速度）或液冷（冷却液、入口温度、流量、压降）

help.en: Air, liquid or underwater; each shows its own conditions.
help.zh-CN: 空气、液体或水下；各自显示对应条件。

label.en: Ambient temperature range (min / max) and altitude
label.zh-CN: 环境温度范围（最低／最高）和海拔

label.en: Housing: open (air through the motor), closed or submerged; IP rating
label.zh-CN: 机壳：开放式（空气流经电机）、封闭式或浸没式；IP等级

label.en: Dust, water, salt, fuel / oil exposure
label.zh-CN: 粉尘、水、盐、燃油／油液暴露

label.en: Max allowed surface temperature (touch, neighbouring parts)
label.zh-CN: 允许的最高表面温度（触碰和邻近部件）

label.en: Envelope: maximum outer diameter and length (with housing)
label.zh-CN: 外形尺寸：最大外径和长度（含机壳）
质量目标（有源部分和整机）

label.en: Mounting: flange / frame, bolt pattern, inner or outer rotor preference
label.zh-CN: 安装方式：法兰／机架、螺栓孔位、内转子或外转子偏好

label.en: Output: shaft or hub interface to the load (propeller hub, gearbox, wheel)
label.zh-CN: 输出端：连接负载的轴或轮毂接口（螺旋桨轮毂、齿轮箱、车轮）

label.en: Bearings in the motor or in the customer's structure
label.zh-CN: 轴承由电机还是客户结构承载

label.en: Loads: axial thrust (and reverse), radial loads, bending moment, gyroscopic moment, tilt rates and accelerations
label.zh-CN: 载荷：轴向推力（及反向推力）、径向载荷、弯矩、陀螺力矩、倾斜角速度和加速度

label.en: Vibration and shock spectra, critical speed / stiffness requirements
label.zh-CN: 振动和冲击谱、临界转速／刚度要求

label.en: Material restrictions (e.g. no rare earth, aerospace materials)
label.zh-CN: 材料限制（例如禁用稀土、航空材料）

help.en: Choose the driven load. Unsupported catalog types remain manual or unknown.
help.zh-CN: 选择驱动负载。没有兼容目录数据时请使用手动特性或标记为未知。

label.en: Standards / certification basis (e.g. EASA SC-VTOL, DO-160, ISO 26262, IEC 60034)
Failure cases to cover: phase short circuit, demagnetisation at fault current, loss of one channel
label.zh-CN: 需覆盖的故障情形：相间短路、故障电流下退磁、单通道失效

label.en: Reliability / MTBF targets, traceability of materials
label.zh-CN: 可靠性／MTBF目标、材料可追溯性

label.en: Tests we must run or support (bench, thermal, endurance, EMC)
label.zh-CN: 需执行或支持的测试（台架、热、耐久、EMC）

label.en: Quantities: prototypes, pre-series, series per year
label.zh-CN: 数量：原型机、预生产、年产量
时间计划：仿真、原型机、量产

label.en: Deliverables expected (simulation report, STEP model, drawings, prototypes, test report)
label.zh-CN: 预期交付物（仿真报告、STEP模型、图纸、原型机、测试报告）

label.en: NDA / IP terms, who owns the design
label.zh-CN: NDA／知识产权条款、设计所有权

label.en: Quantities: prototypes, pre-series, series per year
label.zh-CN: 数量：原型机、预生产、年产量
时间计划：仿真、原型机、量产
